plan: News Coverage & Scheduler Improvements — 24/7 Intelligence Layer
motivation: The current scheduler only runs news scraping on weekdays (Mon-Fri) and only during the live US market window (20:00-05:00 HKT). This means the system is completely silent on weekends, misses post-market moves (4pm-8pm ET = 04:00-08:00 HKT), and ignores pre-market developments. Financial news is continuous — macro events, geopolitical shocks, analyst upgrades, earnings surprises, and Fed commentary can all land on a Saturday and move Monday's open by 3-5%. This plan extends the intelligence layer to true 24/7 coverage with smarter session-aware scheduling.

current_problems.title: Broad news scrape is weekday-only
current_problems.impact: Zero news processed on Saturday and Sunday. Weekend macro/geopolitical/earnings-preview news is completely ignored, leaving Monday's open blind.

current_problems.title: US window excludes post-market
current_problems.impact: Post-market (04:00-08:00 HKT) is not covered. After-hours earnings, Fed commentary, and analyst upgrades/downgrades that land after 4pm ET are never scraped until the next cycle — if at all.

current_problems.title: No dedicated post-market notification
current_problems.impact: After US close there is no summary pushed to Telegram. The user has no awareness of what happened after 4pm ET until the next morning.

current_problems.title: No weekend intelligence digest
current_problems.impact: The system is fully silent Saturday and Sunday. Weekend Telegram is dead. User has no way to passively stay informed unless they manually send !scrape.

current_problems.title: Watchlist scrape (30-min) has no Telegram output on weekends
current_problems.impact: The 30-min watchlist scrape runs every day (no 1-5 filter) but only publishes to the event bus if new articles are found. Because the broad scrape hasn't run to seed the DB on weekends, deduplication means almost nothing gets through. No Telegram message is ever sent from this task on weekends.

phases.title: Expand broad news scrape to 7 days with post-market coverage

change.description: Remove the 1-5 weekday restriction from Task 1 (Broad News). Update the internal window check to cover the full US session including pre-market and post-market. On weekends, use a lighter 4-hourly slot check instead of running every single hour.

code: // Full US session: pre-market (7am ET) through post-market (8pm ET)
// Weekends: run lighter — only at 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 HKT (3x per day)
window_logic_after.note: Weekend slots are deliberately sparse — financial news volume drops 80% on weekends, so hourly is wasteful and produces duplicate batches

phases.title: Add post-market close digest (Mon-Fri, 08:00 HKT = 4pm ET)

scheduler_change.description: Add a new cron task that fires at 08:00 HKT Mon-Fri (exactly when US market closes at 4pm ET). It triggers a fresh broad scrape and sends a post-market digest to Telegram.
code: logger.info('[Scheduler] Post-market digest triggered (US market closed)');

news_agent_change.description: Add an optional mode parameter to scrapeBroadNews() so it can pass a digest type to sendRecap(). This controls the message header and tone.
news_agent_change.sendRecap_signature_after: private async sendRecap(articles: any[], mode: 'standard' | 'post-market' | 'weekend' = 'standard'): Promise<void>
news_agent_change.post_market_extra_line: Appended below the headlines: _Market closed. Next open: {nextOpenDay} 9:30am ET._

phases.title: Add weekend morning digest (09:00 HKT Sat & Sun)

scheduler_change.description: Add a weekend digest cron that fires at 09:00 HKT on Saturday and Sunday. Uses scrapeBroadNews('weekend') so the message is clearly labelled as a weekend brief and not confused with a live trading alert.
scheduler_change.context: 9am HKT Saturday = 9pm ET Friday (after any late US post-market news settles). 9am HKT Sunday = catches any weekend macro/geopolitical developments.
code: await sendTelegramMessage('🗞️ *Weekend Brief:* No new major headlines since last check. Markets are quiet.', 'info');

phases.title: Fix watchlist scrape to send Telegram on weekends when new articles found

change.description: The watchlist scrape publishes to the event bus, but on weekends the StrategyAgent and ExecutionAgent are gated by market hours and won't act on it. Add a direct Telegram notification path for weekends so the user at least knows what news hit their watchlist stocks.
new_code: // On weekends, the event bus pipeline won't fire (market gated).
// Send a direct Telegram digest so the user stays informed.
change.cap: Capped at 8 headlines to keep the Telegram message readable. Full list is still stored in news_intel table.

out_of_scope.reason: Deferred to keep this plan focused on scheduling and coverage, not new data sources
excluded: Pre-market level 2 / dark pool data — requires separate paid data feed
Earnings calendar integration — useful but separate module, not a scheduler fix
Social scrape on weekends — SocialIntelAgent already runs on demand via !scrape, extending it to weekends risks Reddit/X rate limits
Real-time WebSocket news feed — would replace RSS polling entirely, separate architecture decision

risks.mitigation: deduplicateAndStore() already uses ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING — duplicates are silently dropped at DB level. Weekend quiet message handles the case where nothing new is found.

risks.risk: Post-market digest fires at same time as weekly report on Friday (08:00 HKT)
risks.mitigation: Weekly report fires at '0 8 * * 6' (Saturday). Post-market digest fires at '0 8 * * 1-5' (Mon-Fri). No overlap — Saturday is excluded from 1-5.

risks.risk: Weekend news scrape hits Yahoo Finance rate limits
risks.mitigation: Broad scrape uses RSS feeds (Yahoo Finance RSS, Google News RSS, MarketWatch RSS) which are not rate-limited. Yahoo Finance Search fallback is already wrapped in try/catch — a failure here skips that source without crashing.

risks.risk: More frequent Telegram messages could feel noisy
risks.mitigation: Weekend slots are 3x/day max (09:00, 15:00, 21:00 HKT). Post-market is 1x/day. Only sends if new articles are found — quiet market = quiet bot. The 'markets quiet' fallback message on weekends provides reassurance without false signals.
